patches.reason: Stock SkyMP cannot load light (ESL) plugins: the server refuses any .esl name, and any plugin whose masters include an .esl (USSEP, COTN) fails with "unresolved dependency". It also matched master names case-sensitively while the game does not, so USSEP (which lists "ccqdrsse001-survivalmode.esl") could not resolve "ccQDRSSE001-SurvivalMode.esl".
patches.impact: Light plugins are loaded and their forms get the FE-space ids the game gives them (0xFE000000 | lightIndex<<12 | id), so server and client agree on every record. Server log shows "Load order: N full plugins and M light plugins". Client binaries (SkyrimPlatform.dll, MpClientPlugin.dll, skymp5-client.js) are rebuilt from the same tree and must match the server. Risk: records stored in the DB by plugin name are unaffected; a light plugin with a form above 0xFFF would collide (none in the current set).
patches.test: unit.exe "[Light]" (6 cases / 61 assertions) and the full unit suite in the skymp-src build; boot of skymp/server with 22 full + 3 light plugins on 2026-11-19; apps/game-api clientMods.test.js covers serverSupportsLightPlugins mode.
patches.loss_condition: Reinstalling the stock server with scripts/phase0/Install-SkyMPServerArtifact.ps1, or the stock client with Install-SkyMPClient.ps1, or a launcher client-distribution download, silently brings back stock scam_native.node / client DLLs. The server then refuses to boot with the .esl load order. Also lost on a reclone of E:/SkyrimRP/skymp-src without re-applying this diff. skymp/config/client-mods.local.json "serverSupportsLightPlugins": true must then be turned off.
patches.removal_strategy: Delete when upstream SkyMP merges light-plugin support (Thornswood PR #1715 or equivalent) and the pin moves past it.
patches.notes: Core of ThornswoodRP PR #36 (upstream skymp #1715) cherry-picked onto the pin, plus a case-insensitive CombineBrowser::GetFileIndex and a CMakeLists change accepting the "Visual Studio 18 2026" generator. upstream_pr is null because #1715 is the upstream PR and it is not ours. Build tree: E:/SkyrimRP/skymp-src branch oathbound/light-plugins; configure with E:/SkyrimRP/tools/configure-skymp.ps1.

patches.reason: With server-info-ignore (how the OATHBOUND launcher connects) and no signing keys, the client resolves publicKeys to {} instead of undefined, treats that as "keys configured", and rejects every unsigned server snippet with "no signature found". Every mp.makeEventSource and every updateOwner/updateNeighbor function is silently dropped: in-game chat and all other UI events never reach the server, keybinds never sync, panel data never arrives.
patches.impact: An empty key set skips verification exactly like no key set. Servers that configure real public keys still require valid signatures. Client-only change: players need the rebuilt skymp5-client.js.
patches.test: Diagnosed from source and from the database (zero rp_chat audit rows across all sessions while the chat handler, run offline, logs every line). In-game confirmation pending: chat replies, /help, Controls tab loading keybinds.
patches.loss_condition: Installing a stock skymp5-client.js (Install-SkyMPClient.ps1, a launcher client download, or a SkyMP update) brings the bug back silently: chat and UI events stop reaching the server with no error outside the in-game console. Applies on top of light-plugins.patch (same tree).
patches.removal_strategy: Delete when upstream ServerJsVerificationService treats an empty key set as no keys (or getTargetPeer stops merging undefined into {}) and the pin moves past it.
patches.notes: Not yet proposed upstream; small, self-contained candidate for a PR. Applied after light-plugins.patch by scripts/skymp-build/Build-PatchedSkyMP.ps1.

patches.reason: SkyMP's client sets every player's game clock from real UTC time every 2 seconds (year = real year - 2020 + 199, one game day per real day), so the server cannot set its own calendar. OATHBOUND wants 4E 199 in 2026, the real month and day, and a 12-real-hour game day.
patches.impact: Year = real year - 2026 + 199; month/day = real UTC date (Sun's Dawn capped at 28); hour = (real UTC hours mod 12) * 2, shifted by the client hoursOffset setting; TimeScale 2 (nudged 1.2 / 2.4 to stay on the hour). Client-only change: players need the rebuilt skymp5-client.js, which ships in skymp/client-mods.
patches.test: oathboundCalendar checked on fixed instants (00:00, 06:00, 11:59, 12:00, 18:30 UTC, New Year, 29 Feb); bundle built with webpack. In-game confirmation pending.
patches.loss_condition: Installing a stock skymp5-client.js brings back the real-time calendar. Applies on top of light-plugins.patch and client-empty-public-keys.patch (same tree).
patches.removal_strategy: OATHBOUND-specific behaviour; keep while the server wants this calendar.

patches.reason: Stock SkyMP never loads NPCs of the 10 playable races (WorldState::bannedEspmCharacterRaceIds), so bandits, Forsworn, necromancers and every other human or elf enemy never spawn; only creatures do.
patches.impact: New server-settings option "npcAllowPlayableRaces" (default off). When true, races 0x13740-0x13749 (Argonian..WoodElf) leave the ban list; vampire variants, children and mannequins stay banned. Unique/essential NPCs and crime-faction members are still skipped by SkyMP, and npc-spawn-filter.js disables every remaining non-hostile NPC.
patches.test: Server boot with the option on, then a stand-in actor next to Embershard Mine bandits.
patches.loss_condition: A stock scam_native.node ignores the option and the ban returns.
patches.removal_strategy: OATHBOUND-specific; keep while human enemies are wanted.
